This method calculates the coefficients of the multi-variate polynomial representing a multi-linearly interpolated level set (LS) function within a grid cell [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the method calculates coefficients of a multi-variate polynomial representing a multi-linearly interpolated level set function within a grid cell. Source [S1] explicitly confirms this in multiple places: it defines the LS function as multi-linearly interpolated within a grid cell (B.3), expands it to a multi-variate polynomial (B.4), and describes an algorithm to calculate the coefficients $c_k$ from the corner LS values. The source also mentions the optimization to reduce numerical operations, which aligns with the claim's context.
